basic.name: Invisible Air: Barrier of the Wind King
basic.description_template: Deals Wind DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Saber's ATK to one designated enemy.

variants.name: Release, the Golden Scepter
variants.description_template: Gains 2 "Core Resonance" and deals Wind DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Saber's ATK to all enemies. If the number of enemies is 2/1 when this ability is used, additionally deals Wind DMG equal to {{scaling2}}%/{{scaling3}}% of Saber's ATK to all enemies.

skill.name: Strike Air: Hammer of the Wind King
skill.description_template: Deals Wind DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Saber's ATK to one designated enemy, and deals Wind DMG equal to {{scaling2}}% of Saber's ATK to adjacent targets. If Saber currently possesses "Core Resonance" and her Energy can be regenerated to full by consuming "Core Resonance" after this instance of Skill attack, then increase the DMG multiplier for this instance of Skill use by {{scaling3}}% for each stack of "Core Resonance," and consume all "Core Resonance" to regenerate Energy for Saber after attacking. Otherwise, immediately gains 3 point(s) of "Core Resonance."

ultimate.name: Excalibur
ultimate.description_template: Deals Wind DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Saber's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals 10 instance(s) of DMG. Each instance of DMG deals Wind DMG equal to {{scaling2}}% of Saber's ATK to one random enemy. After using Ultimate, the next Basic ATK switches to "Release, the Golden Scepter," and only "Release, the Golden Scepter" can be used.

talent.name: Dragon Reactor Core
talent.description_template: When entering combat, gains 1 "Core Resonance" point(s). When any ally target uses Ultimate, increases the DMG dealt by Saber by {{scaling1}}% for 2 turn(s) and gains 3 "Core Resonance" point(s). For every 1 "Core Resonance" point consumed, regenerates a fixed amount of 8 Energy for Saber.

technique.name: Behold, the King of Knights
technique.description: After using Technique, increases Saber's ATK by 35.0% for 2 turn(s) at the start of the next battle and gains 2 "Core Resonance".

2.name: Knight of the Dragon
2.description: Increases Saber's CRIT Rate by 20%. When entering battle and when using her Enhanced Basic ATK, obtains the "Mana Burst" effect. Under the effect, if Saber has "Core Resonance" and her Energy can be fully regenerated by using her Skill and consuming "Core Resonance," consumes "Mana Burst" to recover 1 Skill Point for allies, and Saber immediately takes action.

4.name: Blessing of the Lake
4.description: Saber can accumulate up to 120 excess Energy. After using Ultimate, the excess Energy is cleared and a corresponding amount is regenerated. When the battle starts, if Energy is below 60%, it is regenerated to 60%.

6.name: Crown of the Star
6.description: When using Skill, increases Saber's CRIT DMG by 50% for 2 turns. During this battle, for each point of "Core Resonance" gained, increases Saber's CRIT DMG by 4%, stacking up to 8 time(s).

eidolons.name: The Lost White Walls
eidolons.description: Increases Ultimate DMG dealt by Saber by 60%. After Saber uses a Basic ATK or Skill, gains 1 "Core Resonance."

eidolons.name: The Lost Oath of the Round Table
eidolons.description: For each point of "Core Resonance" gained in this battle, Saber's DMG dealt ignores 1% of the target's DEF. This effect can stack up to 15 time(s). When triggering the "Core Resonance's" Skill multiplier effect, each point of "Core Resonance" additionally increases the DMG multiplier for this instance of Skill by 7%.

eidolons.name: A Wish Across Fifteen Centuries
eidolons.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: The Saga of Sixteen Winter Days
eidolons.description: Increases Saber's Wind RES PEN  by 8%. After using Ultimate, increases Saber's Wind RES PEN  by 4%. This effect can stack up to 3 time(s).

eidolons.name: The Dreamed Utopian Dawn
eidolons.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: The Long Fated Night
eidolons.description: Wind RES PEN  of Ultimate DMG dealt by Saber increases by 20%, and the Overflow Energy that can be accumulated by the Trace "Blessing of the Lake" increases to 200. When using Ultimate for the first time after entering battle, regenerates a fixed 300 Energy for Saber. This effect can be triggered 1 time after every 3 Ultimate use(s).
